metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the list, the bill for The Siege of London, and the talk at the Bishopsgate post.

yesterday: Raye brought back three hundred and twenty-five elm boards, at twenty-four shillings, and the lime-tubs.
The old bill stays on the post. The Rose is idle, and so is the company.
The Queen's money is still on the list.
The letter and the horse are still on the list.
